_meta.scope: Every candidate in 7 near-eligible races: tx-ltgov, ca-ltgov, tx-37, tx-house-51, ca-ag, ca-controller, ca-spi.
_meta.scale: -5..+5 on the feat2/lib/issues.ts axes; score null + status "unsure" means ambiguous and not scored.
_meta.fairness: Each race was searched with the same source types for every candidate (own site, official statement, LWV/SOS guide, same news guide) and on every axis, not only the trailing candidate's gap. Races were not stopped once eligible. Races that could only become eligible on thin or one-sided sourcing were left ineligible.
rulesApplied: public-employee pay not scored on wages
recorded votes go in voteRecord, never quotes
charter-only or vague "educational choices" statements not scored on education
campus or school-safety statements not scored on safety (Phil Kim batch3, Arellano and Garibay batch6)
one sentence counts toward one issue only
candidate own words with a year and URL; endorsements and reporter paraphrase do not count
